speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Migraine and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That diagnosis of migraine does not fit with your high fever, generalized rigidity, and disorientation; those signs strongly suggest a serious infection like meningitis or encephalitis. While we await the results of your blood work, lumbar puncture, and cultures, have you had any recent head trauma, exposure to ticks, or a rash?
